artworks.title: Sorrow (Chagrin)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract form on a patterned surface. It features a series of etched lines and shapes suggesting a fluid, organic form resting on a textured surface. The background has vertical lines. The monochrome palette and sketch-like quality give the artwork a raw and intimate feel.

artworks.title: Pompilia
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length portrait of a person in a contemplative pose. The individual has long, dark hair, closed or partially closed eyes, and is wearing a patterned garment. The image is monochromatic with a textured appearance, and the background is a simple, textured surface.

artworks.title: Peppina
artworks.medium: etching with graphite additions on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a head-and-shoulders view. The individual is positioned slightly turned to the side with their head tilted towards the viewer. Their facial features include prominent eyes, a subtle smile, and a relatively smooth complexion. The person's hair is dark and appears short, styled closely around the head. They are wearing a simple garment suggested by the etching strokes with no intricate details visible. No jewelry or objects are evident in the person's attire or within their grasp. The background consists of a textured pattern created by consistent cross-hatching, giving the piece depth and focus on the subject.

artworks.title: Peppina
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a person's upper body, primarily focusing on the face and shoulders. The person is in a three-quarter position, turning slightly to one side. The facial features are drawn with prominently drawn eyes and a delicate smile. The person has textured, voluminous hair that frames the face. The clothing depicted is simple with horizontal lines suggesting fabric folds around the shoulders. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects being held. The background is a subtle, blurred texture with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Peppina
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woman from the shoulders up. She is facing slightly to the right with her head turned towards the viewer. The woman has delicate facial features and a composed expression. Her hair is styled in an updo. She appears to be wearing a patterned garment. The background is textured with fine lines. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Birth Announcement for Anne-Élisabeth Besnard (Carte de naissance d'Anne-Élisabeth Besnard)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. On the left, an elderly person is standing and holding an infant. The elderly person has spectacles and a headscarf, wearing a long garment with textured patterns. The infant is wrapped up. On the right, another person is reclining on a bed, partially covered by a blanket and pillows. The background shows a patterned wall or curtain and a bedpost.

artworks.title: Seated Nude with a Cigarette
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The artwork depicts the upper body of a person seated in a three-quarter view. The person is leaning with their left arm resting on a surface while their right hand holds a small object, possibly a flower. The facial features of the person are softly rendered, with a focus on their large eyes and serene expression. The person's hair is styled in a wavy bob that falls around their face. The figure is nude from the waist up, partially draped with a cloth or blanket across the lap. The background is textured with cross-hatching and shading, creating a neutral space that emphasizes the subject's presence.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: collotype in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of the upper half of a man's body. He is shown in a relaxed, frontal position with a beard, mustache, and short hair. His eyes are looking forward. He is wearing a loose garment or cloak, and the sketch is set against a plain background with shading lines. The artist's signature and the date "1893" are visible beside the man's head.

artworks.title: A Cottage at Dorking in Surrey
artworks.medium: gray wash and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic half-timbered building with a sharp, angular roof. The horizon is in the middle with a faint misty line hinting at distant land and possibly water. A lone figure stands nearby. The building has clean lines and soft brushstrokes to depict the texture of the walls. The color scheme is mostly monochromatic with shades of grey, beige, and soft sepia. The brushstrokes create a serene atmosphere, suggesting shadows over the landscape and trees in the background blending into the sky.

artworks.title: Male Nude
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white on brown paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a figure in a dynamic stance, with one arm bent and the other extended out to the right. The figure's head is partially obscured, turned to the right and tilted slightly back. They appear to have short, curly hair. The person is nude, with some curling, scribbled lines around the waist and groin. One of the person's legs is also bent, resting on an indistinct block on the left. The person casts a shadow below them and to the left, but aside from that the background is empty. The drawing has been done in red on beige paper.

artworks.title: Male Nude
artworks.medium: red chalk on tan oatmeal paper, heightened with white chalk

artworks.title: Emigrants
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: Four people are depicted from head to knee, positioned closely together. On the left, a person wearing a dotted headscarf is seated, resting their head on their hand and looking downward. Next to them, a person with short, dark hair partially covered by a dark scarf gazes intently ahead. They are dressed in a dark coat. The third person is mostly covered by a patterned blanket, hiding most of their features except for a glimpse of their closed eyes and part of their face. Standing behind them is a person with a textured beard, wearing a cap and long dark clothing, appearing to look downwards towards the group. The background is a simple textured surface.

artworks.title: Invention d'une Cascade (Design for a Cascade)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an intricate fountain surrounded by decorative elements in a garden. The fountain features ornate detailing, including sculptural figures and foliage. Elegantly dressed individuals are near the fountain. The scene is framed by scrollwork and floral motifs. The background shows lush greenery, tall trees, a wall, and decorative architectural elements.

artworks.title: Project d'une Grotte (Plan for a Grotto)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate grotto design with intricate details including curling leaf motifs and scrolls. In the center is a seated female figure surrounded by other figures, set within a grand niche. A water fountain element and surrounding foliage enhance the design. The style appears to reflect the Rococo style of the 18th century.

artworks.title: Dessein d'une Fontaine orné avec les quatre Elements (Design for a Fountain Decorated with the Four Elements)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts an ornate fountain with Baroque-style architectural elements and decorative figures like putti and intricate carvings. A child-like figure stands on top of an archway, while others are positioned around the fountain, with lush foliage surrounding it. The fountain is adorned with a relief of a face, along with sculptures and engravings adding to its ornamental appearance.

artworks.title: Tolozan de Montfort
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving featuring the upper part of a man's body in a profile view. The man is facing to the right, displaying his head and upper chest. His facial details are intricate, with a prominent nose and a serene expression. His hair is styled in a curled fashion and tied at the back with a bow. He is dressed in a decorated coat and a high-collared, laced shirt. The drawing includes decorative elements like a floral and laurel wreath surrounding the man's profile in an oval frame. Beneath the frame, there is a sculpted mask and draped fabric. The background is textured with fine lines.

artworks.title: Annibale Carracci
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper, laid down
artworks.dimensions: overall (trimmed to plate mark): 13.2 x 10.7 cm (5 3/16 x 4 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait sketch of a man with a distinctive facial structure. His features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and slightly pursed lips. He has short, wavy dark hair and wears a dark coat with a white collar. The portrait features textured shading. The background has horizontal line patterns and the inscription "ANIBAL CARAS PICTOR" at the top.

artworks.title: Pierre Mignard
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person looking directly at the viewer. The person has a solemn expression with distinctive facial features and curly hair. They are dressed in elegant attire with a high collar. The background includes an oval frame around the figure and text mentioning the name "Pierre Mignard."

artworks.title: Satyr Carrying a Nymph
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures in a forest setting. The image displays a central figure that appears to have the features of a satyr, holding another creature on its shoulder. Another figure is near them, clutching an amphora, knee-deep in water. Surrounding them, lush vegetation with finely detailed foliage suggests a rich, dense forest. The texture and shading are composed of intricate lines and cross-hatching, giving depth and contrast to the scene.

artworks.title: Anton Raphael Mengs
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 25.2 x 20.6 cm (9 15/16 x 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing a man from the chest upwards. He has distinct facial features, including high cheekbones and a prominent forehead, with medium-length, wavy hair framing his face. The man is wearing a historical garment with a layered collar and a scarf around his neck. The background is a plain oval shape with dark texture, and the name "MENGS" is displayed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Marie-Thérèse-Charlotte, Duchess of Angoulême
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Piat Joseph Sauvage
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a woman in profile. She has delicate facial features and a gentle smile. Her curly hair is styled elaborately with a ribbon or headband, and she wears a lace collar. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate circular frame with floral and ribbon decorations at the top. Below the frame, there is a nameplate with inscriptions. The background is textured and dark within a rectangular border, giving the image a formal presentation.

artworks.title: Illusionistic Ceiling with a Grape Arbor, Figures Poised on Galleries, and a Central Scene of Olympian Gods
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white, over black chalk on brown paper (sheet enlarged at right and bottom by the artist)
artworks.description: The image features architectural designs and mythological figures. It displays a complex composition with segmented sections showcasing architectural elements like arches and columns, paired with mythological imagery. The upper part shows dynamic figures within swirling clouds and horses. In the center, there is a circular scene with additional figures in a sculptural arrangement. The right side is adorned with floral ornamentation and decorative patterns. The drawing reflects a style reminiscent of a Renaissance or Mannerist artist, emphasizing strong architectural forms and intricate mythical themes.

artworks.title: The "Canopus" of the Villa Adriana at Tivoli
artworks.medium: red chalk over black chalk on heavy laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This drawing is a view of an interior architecture scene similar to an ancient ruin. It is a large, vaulted space flanked by dilapidated walls. The structure features several arches, with some areas showing signs of decay and vegetation overgrowth. Farther back is an area that seems to open up slightly in the distance. The drawing's technique consists of loose, expressive lines with cross-hatching and shading. The lines are red on beige paper.

artworks.title: A Palatial Wall Ornamented with Sculptures and Paintings
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a complex architectural design with ornate decorative elements. The drawing shows the façade of a building or a conceptualized architectural structure featuring intricate details typical of classical architecture. It includes three levels adorned with sculptures set within niches, decorative cornices, and ornamental panels. The top section includes garlands, putti, and urns. Human figures in relief are depicted across the top two levels, enclosed in rounded niches, while more elaborate scenes with multiple figures are seen in two central panels on the middle level. The bottom portion of the structure is simpler with rectangular outlines. Thin pen lines and a light wash suggest that the drawing serves as a preparatory study or design proposal for an architectural project.
